categories.title: General
categories.description: The essentials for getting expert support underway.

questions.question: What is Tech Savvy Virtual Assistance?
questions.answer: It is an on-demand team for practical IT and digital work. You explain the outcome you need in chat, and an expert completes the work against your available credit.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Create your account, receive your sign-up credit, add funds when needed, then start a chat with a clear goal, deadline, and any useful access or reference material.

questions.question: Who will work on my request?
questions.answer: Your request is matched with an expert whose skills fit the job, from development and automation to design, analytics, marketing, and technical operations.

questions.question: Can I use the service for a one-time task?
questions.answer: Yes. The credit-based model works for focused tasks, ongoing improvements, and recurring operational support without requiring a long contract.

questions.question: How do I communicate requirements?
questions.answer: Use chat to describe the desired result, share examples, answer questions, and review progress. A concise brief helps the expert estimate and begin quickly.

categories.title: Tech Stack & Services
categories.description: Modern technology, creative production, and connected operations.

questions.question: What types of work can your experts handle?
questions.answer: We support web and app development, PWAs, workflow automation, UI/UX, digital design, data analytics, ecommerce, social media marketing, video, motion design, and hosting.

questions.question: Which technologies do you work with?
questions.answer: Our toolkit includes Next.js, React, React Native, .NET, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Power BI, Figma, Canva, WooCommerce, HubSpot, GitHub, Make, and n8n.

questions.question: Can you improve an existing site or application?
questions.answer: Yes. Share the issue and current stack. We can investigate bugs, improve performance, add a feature, refresh interfaces, connect systems, or document a practical next step.

questions.question: Do you offer automation and data reporting?
questions.answer: Yes. We can connect the tools you already use, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into clearer dashboards, reports, and decisions.

questions.question: Can you create brand and marketing assets too?
questions.answer: Yes. Design specialists can prepare interface concepts, branded graphics, social content, video edits, motion assets, and campaign materials that fit your goals.

categories.title: Pay As You Go
categories.description: Straightforward credit and time-based billing without retainers.

questions.question: How does Pay As You Go billing work?
questions.answer: Work is charged from your account credit at the applicable hourly rate. You only add credit when you need more capacity, with no mandatory monthly retainer.

questions.question: What is the introductory rate?
questions.answer: For your first month, expert time is $5 per hour. After the first month, the standard hourly rate is $10 per hour.

questions.question: Do I receive credit when I sign up?
questions.answer: Yes. New users receive $50 in account credit at sign-up, giving you room to begin a task and experience the workflow.

questions.question: Will I know the expected cost before work begins?
questions.answer: After reviewing your request, the expert will clarify scope and expected effort in chat. You can ask questions or adjust the brief before authorizing work.

questions.question: What happens when my credit is low?
questions.answer: Add credit to continue uninterrupted. Your expert can also help prioritize the most valuable next step when the available balance is limited.

categories.title: Partners
categories.description: Flexible delivery support for agencies and growing teams.

questions.question: Who is the partner program for?
questions.answer: It is designed for agencies, consultants, startups, and in-house teams that need dependable specialist capacity without building every capability internally.

questions.question: Can you work behind the scenes for my clients?
questions.answer: Yes. Share the preferred collaboration style and delivery expectations in your initial conversation so the engagement can be structured appropriately.

questions.question: What work can partners delegate?
questions.answer: Partners can delegate technical builds, design production, analytics, automation, content assets, maintenance, and defined project slices that need specialist attention.

questions.question: How do partners keep delivery aligned?
questions.answer: Use the chat to set priorities, provide brand or technical context, review milestones, and keep feedback close to the work as it progresses.

questions.question: Can I start small before scaling up?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Begin with a well-defined task, evaluate the quality and communication, then expand into ongoing support when the working rhythm is right.

categories.title: Maintenance & Support
categories.description: Keep important digital work healthy after launch.

questions.question: Do you provide post-launch maintenance?
questions.answer: Yes. We can help with updates, fixes, performance checks, security-minded housekeeping, hosting tasks, and steady improvement after a site or product launches.

questions.question: Can you take over an existing project?
questions.answer: Yes. Start by sharing the stack, current issue, and available documentation. We will assess the next practical action and identify any access or context needed.

questions.question: How quickly can support begin?
questions.answer: Timing depends on the request's clarity, complexity, and required access. A focused first message helps us match an expert and begin the conversation quickly.

questions.question: Can you help with hosting, domains, and SSL?
questions.answer: Yes. Our support includes managed hosting tasks, domain and SSL coordination, backups, updates, and other maintenance activities needed to keep a service dependable.

questions.question: What should I include in a support request?
questions.answer: Include the goal or issue, urgency, affected URL or system, screenshots or errors, recent changes, and the access details needed to investigate safely.
